recommendation: Introduce discount governance: cap standard discounts at 20% and require approval above it
evidence: 22% of lines are discounted >20% and lose 814,682 overall
estimated_impact: +815k (all affected sales lost) to +924k (50% retained) profit; up to +1,032k if no volume is lost
kpi: Share of lines >20% discount; margin by discount band

recommendation: Reprice and re-negotiate the Tables line (limit discounts, review supplier cost)
evidence: Tables lose 64,083 with an average discount of 29%

recommendation: Run pricing reviews for EMEA and the most loss-making countries (Turkey, Nigeria, Netherlands, ...)
evidence: 29 countries lose 447,900; EMEA margin is 5.4% vs 24.6% at discounts <=20%
estimated_impact: Top-10 loss-making countries lose 355,055 (largely overlaps with #1)
kpi: Margin by country; number of loss-making countries

recommendation: Customer programme: protect the top 20% of customers and set discount terms for unprofitable accounts
estimated_impact: Up to 157k of customer-level losses addressable (overlaps with #1)
kpi: Profit per customer; retention of top 20%

recommendation: Review express shipping: charge for it, or steer low-priority orders to Standard
evidence: Express = 20% of sales but 31% of shipping cost
estimated_impact: About 118k (illustrative; validate how profit treats shipping)
kpi: Shipping cost % of sales by mode

recommendation: Restart new-customer acquisition, as growth currently depends on a saturated customer base
Plan inventory, staffing and promotions around the Q4 peak; use non-discount incentives in the Jan-Feb trough
